description: If \(T\) is consistent and the constant \(c\) occurs neither in \(T\) nor in the body \(\varphi(x)\), then \(T\cup\{\exists x\,\varphi(x)\to\varphi(c)\}\) is consistent.
signature:

  {T : Set (L.Formula ℕ)} (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T) (φ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ 1)
  (c : ℕ) (hcT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.FreshFor c T) (hcφ : c ∉ φ.freeVarFinset) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent
    (insert (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.witnessAxiom φ c) T)
